The new KFC commercial is going viral—and for all the wrong reasons. In this dark, controversial ad, Kentucky Fried Chicken depicts a cult-like ritual in the woods where a man is baptized in a lake of hot grease and emerges as a piece of fried chicken, sparking outrage online. Viewers are calling it disturbing, satanic, and proof of hidden symbolism in fast food marketing. This creepy KFC commercial has reignited conspiracy theories about the meat industry, cannibalism, and the disturbing idea that human meat could be hidden in our food supply. In this video, we break down the symbolism, decode the hidden message, and explore the growing claims that fast food ads are getting darker and more disturbing. Is KFC pushing an agenda, or is this just shock advertising gone too far? Watch and decide for yourself.
